title: Armorium
description: Plenty of armors, powers, and much more!
body:
### Plenty of armors, powers, and much more!  
Armorium is a mod that adds custom and unique vanilla-like loot.  
Ranging from Ruby Equipments to emerald and so much more!




## Translation
Help me make the mod more accessible to other players around the world:  
[Crowdin Page]([https://crowdin.com/project/armorium](https://crowdin.com/project/armorium))

# Pre release notes:
I worked on Armorium for almost three months. This is my very first mod.
It might be unbalanced at points and unplayable on singleplayer/multiplayer.

**CAUTION:**
> Tested in singleplayer only.
No compatibility testing with other mods.
Conflicts are possible.
Not ready for public use.


## Content:
- Ruby armor set
- Ruby blocks
- Drills
- Multitool, vein miner implementation.
- Achievable (in survival) status effects.
- Proof of concept / WIP status effects.

This is only the first release that is in a state of playability. 
I'm planning on making so much more content but I don't have a lot of time, don't expect frequent releases.

Plans: Much more armors and tools, temporary and permanent powers and status effects, and accessories.
